professions.name: Metalworking & Smithing
professions.description: The sacred forge discipline of Hephaestus, encompassing bronze forging, adamantine armaments, orichalcum refinement, and temple jewellery smithing.

professions.name: Mechanical Engineering & Artifice
professions.description: Daedalian mechanical ingenuity, crafting automaton sentinels, bronze gearwork contrivances, locking devices, and mechanical prosthetics.

professions.name: Textiles, Leatherworking & Garments
professions.description: Spinning, leather tanning, and Tyrian dyeing inspired by Arachne and the Moirai, crafting enchanted cloaks, beast-hide boots, and linothorax cuirasses.

professions.name: Alchemy & Herbalism
professions.description: Compounding sacred botanical draughts, Dittany salves, Moly distillations, and combat concoctions derived from legendary beasts.

professions.name: Stonework, Sculpture & Pottery
professions.description: Pygmalion sculpting, Pentelic marble masonry, and enchanted amphora pottery capable of storing essences and animated stone reliefs.

professions.name: Instrument Making & Musical Craft
professions.description: Orphic crafting of resonant tortoiseshell lyres, boxwood auloi flutes, and silver harps attuned to planetary harmonies.

professions.name: Scribing & Magical Inscription
professions.description: Inscribing prophetic parchments, protective threshold wards, and illuminated mythological treatises with enchanted inks and gold leaf.

toolkits.name: Hephaestian Smithing Kit

toolkits.name: Daedalian Artifice Kit
toolkits.description: Calipers, delicate bronze screwdrivers, gears, and balance weights.

toolkits.name: Textile & Leatherworking Kit
toolkits.description: Bone needles, sinew spools, awls, and scraper shears.

toolkits.name: Asklepian Alchemist Kit
toolkits.description: Agate mortar, glass alembic, copper vials, and precision herb shears.

toolkits.name: Pygmalion Sculptor Kit
toolkits.description: Hardened chisels, wooden mallet, pumice stone, and polishing rags.

toolkits.name: Orphic Instrument Kit
toolkits.description: Gauged gut stringer, peg reamer, tuning fork, and carving knives.

toolkits.name: Hierophant Scribing Kit
toolkits.description: Egyptian reed pens, gall inkpot, bone folder, and gum arabic binder.

toolkits.name: Fieldcraft & Gathering Kit
toolkits.description: Iron trowel, foraging sickle, mineral chisel, and specimen satchel.
